summary: The open AI model ecosystem centers on Hugging Face as the dominant repository, which crossed 3 million public models in August 2026, alongside a growing set of developer-facing inference platforms like Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow that make running open-weight models fast and accessible. Download activity is highly concentrated—roughly half of all models have fewer than 200 downloads, while the top 200 models account for nearly half of all downloads—and China has surpassed the U.S. in monthly model downloads. These hubs and APIs are distinct from enterprise aggregators (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and MLOps platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI), focusing instead on open distribution and low-friction inference.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central hub for hosting, sharing, and discovering open-source AI models, datasets, and demo Spaces, plus hosted inference and endpoints.
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public hosting and community use; Pro ($9/mo); Inference Endpoints and dedicated compute billed by usage; Enterprise plans available
features: Largest open model and dataset repository
Model and dataset versioning via Git/LFS
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Transformers, Diffusers, and other open-source libraries
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML developers, and organizations needing the broadest selection of open models, datasets, and collaboration tooling.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A tool for running open-weight LLMs locally on your own machine with a simple command-line and API interface.
platforms.model_count: ~200+ curated models in its library (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; runs on local hardware so cost is your own compute; optional cloud offering for larger models
features: One-command local model download and run
Easy integration with local app frameworks
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally for prototyping, offline use, or on-device inference.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running and deploying open-source models (image, video, audio, and language) via API without managing infrastructure.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use based on compute time (per-second GPU/CPU billing); no subscription required
features: Run models via simple API with no infra setup
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Strong support for image/video generation models
platforms.best_for: App developers who want to call open models (especially generative image/video/audio) via API or deploy their own with minimal ops.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A developer inference cloud offering fast, scalable serving and fine-tuning of open-source LLMs and multimodal models.
platforms.model_count: ~200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (varies by model size); hourly GPU rental for dedicated endpoints and training
features: Support for the latest open frontier models
platforms.best_for: Developers and companies building production apps on open models who need low-latency, scalable API inference and fine-tuning.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference platform focused on fast, cost-efficient serving of open-source LLMs and multimodal models in production.
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; on-demand GPU pricing for dedicated deployments; fine-tuning billed by usage
features: Optimized FireAttention inference engine for speed
Fine-tuning (including LoRA) and custom model hosting
Function calling and JSON mode support
platforms.best_for: Production teams prioritizing inference speed and cost-efficiency for open LLM and multimodal workloads.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: An inference platform (strong in the China market) providing API access to a broad range of open-source LLM, image, audio, and video models.
platforms.model_count: ~100+ open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token / pay-per-use; competitive low-cost pricing with free credits for some models
features: Strong catalog of Chinese open models (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM)
Text, image, audio, and video model support
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia) seeking affordable API access to leading Chinese and global open-weight models.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers through a single endpoint.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of models aggregated from dozens of providers
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token, pass-through provider pricing plus a small markup; some free model tiers
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Automatic fallback and routing between providers
Access to both open and closed models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want one API to access and compare many open and proprietary models with provider redundancy.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform using custom LPU hardware to serve open-source LLMs at very high speeds.
platforms.model_count: A curated set of popular open models (Llama, Mixtral, Gemma, Qwen, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token with highly competitive rates; free developer tier available
features: Custom LPU hardware for extreme inference speed
Curated selection of top open models
platforms.best_for: Developers building real-time, latency-sensitive applications on open LLMs.
